mapper.sql: (NVL(M.TEACHER_COST, 0) + NVL(M.MATERIAL_COST, 0) + NVL(M.FIELD_COST, 0) + NVL(M.FOOD_COST, 0) + NVL(M.STAY_COST, 0) + NVL(M.TRAFFIC_COST, 0) + NVL(M.VISA_COST, 0) + NVL(M.OTHER_COST, 0))
(SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(1) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE COUNT(1) END FROM EDU_FREE_EMPLOYEE F WHERE F.BASIC_NO = E.BASIC_NO)

TO_CHAR(M.COST_NO) AS COST_NO, TO_CHAR(E.BASIC_NO) AS BASIC_NO, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(E.TRAIN_TYPE_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS TRAIN_TYPE_CODE_NAME, E.COURSE_NAME_CODE, E.PERIOD_TIME, TO_CHAR(E.IMPLE_START_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS IMPLE_START_DATE, TO_CHAR(E.IMPLE_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS IMPLE_END_DATE, P.BUDGET, CASE WHEN M.COST_NO IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE END AS ALL_COST, CASE WHEN M.COST_NO IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ROUND( / ) END AS AVG_COST, AS TOTAL_COUNT, M.TEACHER_COST, M.MATERIAL_COST, M.FIELD_COST, M.FOOD_COST, M.STAY_COST, M.TRAFFIC_COST, M.VISA_COST, M.OTHER_COST, M.REMARK
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM EDU_BASIC_INFORMATION E LEFT JOIN EDU_COST_MANAGER M ON M.BASIC_NO = E.BASIC_NO AND M.ACTIVITY = 1 LEFT JOIN EDU_PLAN_MANAGER P ON P.PLAN_NO = E.PLAN_NO WHERE E.ACTIVITY = '1' AND E.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND UPPER(E.COURSE_NAME_CODE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{courseName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) || '%'
AND E.IMPLE_START_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{startDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
AND E.IMPLE_END_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{endDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
ORDER BY E.CREATE_DATE DESC

SELECT FROM EDU_COST_MANAGER M JOIN EDU_BASIC_INFORMATION E ON E.BASIC_NO = M.BASIC_NO LEFT JOIN EDU_PLAN_MANAGER P ON P.PLAN_NO = E.PLAN_NO WHERE M.COST_NO = #{costNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND M.ACTIVITY = 1 AND M.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.update: UPDATE EDU_COST_MANAGER SET TEACHER_COST = #{teacherCost, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, MATERIAL_COST = #{materialCost, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, FIELD_COST = #{fieldCost, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, FOOD_COST = #{foodCost, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, STAY_COST = #{stayCost, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, TRAFFIC_COST = #{trafficCost, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, VISA_COST = #{visaCost, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, OTHER_COST = #{otherCost, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, REMARK = #{remark, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_IP = #{adminIP, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE COST_NO = #{costNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
